title: Orbiting phone close-up with a quiet brand finish
summary: A vivid phone fills the frame through three continuous 3D passes, then settles beside a short product line before collapsing to a mark and a restrained closing credit.
use_when: a phone app needs a cinematic hero teaser
one product screen and one numeric proof point can carry the story
a short launch bumper needs a mark-led finish

look.type_style: regular neutral sans, sentence case, open tracking, 7% of frame height; bold numeric display at about 18% of frame height

sfx.event: brand mark replaces the product layout

structure.shot: A bright phone screen sweeps from an extreme lower-edge close-up into a readable product view on black.
structure.camera: orbit-3d; push-in 1.00 to 1.26 over the first 30 fr, then a shallow downward drift
structure.motion: device enters from above with easings.outExpo 9 fr (±0.25 s), then follows easings.inOutSine through an 82 fr orbit

structure.shot: The phone returns from the lower right; a large one-digit currency result stays centred as the device crosses left.
structure.camera: orbit-3d with a right-to-left pan across about 53% W; push-in 1.00 to 1.14 over 143 fr
structure.motion: device entrance easings.outExpo 12 fr (±0.25 s); continuous orbit uses easings.inOutSine over 131 fr

structure.shot: The phone clears the left edge, re-enters from below at a new angle, then grows to another edge-to-edge detail.
structure.camera: orbit-3d; push-in 1.00 to 1.29 over 97 fr while the device travels from lower right toward centre
structure.motion: whip-pan exit and re-entry over about 23 fr (±0.25 s), then easings.inOutSine orbit through the hold

structure.shot: A full phone settles on the right while a four-word placeholder statement builds in two lines on the left.
structure.camera: locked two-column framing after the 10 fr device entrance; phone centre at about 68% W
structure.motion: phone rises with easings.outExpo 10 fr (±0.25 s); words reveal every about 8 fr with easings.outExpo 9 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: A small monochrome mark replaces the product layout, rotates about a quarter turn, and settles at centre.
structure.camera: static; centred mark at about 8% H
structure.motion: mark rotation and corner settle use springs.heavy over about 30 fr (overshoot not measurable), then hold 38 fr

structure.shot: A short three-word maker credit replaces the mark and holds alone on black through the silent tail.
structure.camera: pull-out 1.10 to 1.00 over 9 fr with springs.cameraOut, then static
structure.motion: credit resolves with easings.outExpo 9 fr (±0.25 s), followed by an 84 fr still hold

params.productScreen: portrait UI copy: eyebrow, helper and primaryAction
params.proofValue: one short numeric result rendered as the dominant screen figure
params.statement: one four-word product line designed to wrap to two lines
params.mark: one-character monochrome mark for the closing transition
params.creditLine: three-word maker or product credit for the final hold
params.deviceColor: dark phone body contrasting with the bright screen
params.screenColor: one high-luminance accent used as the phone-screen field

notes: Two hard cuts at 3.00 s and 10.97 s; only 1/2 is within ±2 fr of a detected beat, so cut_on_beat is false. Device entrances, whip duration, word cadence, rotation settle and overshoot are limited to 0.25 s sheet resolution. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. OrbitPhoneRig is a deterministic recipe-local CSS 3D rebuild with replaceable UI copy and colours.
